# Embeddings and retrieval

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-reference.swift from the Quiver 1.6.0 public API. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every API below exists in Quiver 1.0.0 and later unless it is tagged *(since X)*. Each entry is the declaration, then the first line of its documentation.

## Chunk

`struct Chunk` — A single fragment of a larger document, paired with its position. *(since 1.5.0)*

Conforms to: Codable, Equatable.

- `let index: Int` — The position of this fragment in the sequence the chunker produced, starting at zero. A retrieved chunk reports this so the answer can cite which fragment it came from. *(since 1.5.0)*
- `let text: String` — The fragment text. *(since 1.5.0)*
- `init(index: Int, text: String)` — Creates a chunk at a given position. *(since 1.5.0)*

## Chunker

`protocol Chunker : Sendable` — A strategy for splitting a document into retrievable fragments. *(since 1.5.0)*

- `func chunk(_ text: String) -> [Chunk]` — Splits a document into ordered fragments. Returns: The fragments, in document order, or an empty array when the document yields none. *(since 1.5.0)*

## String extensions where some Chunker: Chunker

- `func chunked(using chunker: some Chunker) -> [Chunk]` — Splits this document into fragments using the given strategy. Returns: The fragments the chunker produced, in document order. *(since 1.5.0)*

## Sequence extensions where Self.Element == String

- `func asChunks() -> [Chunk]` — Turns a sequence of raw pieces into trimmed, numbered chunks. Returns: The trimmed, non-empty pieces as chunks numbered from zero. *(since 1.5.0)*

## Embedder

`protocol Embedder : Sendable` — A source of text embeddings. *(since 1.4.0)*

- `func embed(_ text: String) -> [Double]?` — Embeds a single piece of text. Returns: A fixed-dimension vector, or `nil` when the text cannot be embedded (empty input, or no recognized tokens). *(since 1.4.0)*

## Array extensions where Element == String

- `func embedded(using embedder: some Embedder) -> [(text: String, vector: [Double])]` — Embeds every string in this array, pairing each vector with its source text. Returns: A `(text, vector)` pair for each successfully embedded string, in order. *(since 1.4.0)*
- `func embed(using embeddings: [String : [Double]]) -> [[Double]]` — Converts an array of words to their vector embeddings by looking up each word in the embeddings dictionary. Returns: Array of vectors for words found in the embeddings dictionary

## Array extensions where Element == (text: Label, vector: [Double])

- `func mostSimilar<Label>(to query: [Double], k: Int) -> [(rank: Int, text: Label, score: Double)] where Element == (text: Label, vector: [Double])` — Ranks these embedded texts by cosine similarity to a query vector. Returns: The top `k` matches as `(rank, text, score)`, highest score first. *(since 1.4.0)*

## RetrievedHit

`struct RetrievedHit<Label> where Label : Decodable, Label : Encodable, Label : Equatable` — One ranked match from a retrieval: a stored payload paired with its similarity to the query. *(since 1.5.0)*

Conforms to: Codable, Equatable.

- `let rank: Int` — The match's position in the ranked results, starting at one. *(since 1.5.0)*
- `let label: Label` — The stored payload this hit refers to. *(since 1.5.0)*
- `let score: Double` — The cosine similarity of this hit to the query, in `-1...1`. *(since 1.5.0)*
- `init(rank: Int, label: Label, score: Double)` — Creates a ranked hit. *(since 1.5.0)*

## RetrievalResult

`struct RetrievalResult<Label> where Label : Decodable, Label : Encodable, Label : Equatable` — The outcome of one retrieval: the top-k hits, plus the full score field they were drawn from and its summary statistics. *(since 1.5.0)*

- `let hits: [RetrievedHit<Label>]` — The top-k matches, ranked best first. *(since 1.5.0)*
- `let scores: [Double]` — The cosine score of every stored entry against the query, in storage order — the full field, not just the returned hits. *(since 1.5.0)*
- `let mean: Double` — The mean of the full score field. *(since 1.5.0)*
- `let standardDeviation: Double` — The standard deviation (sample, `ddof: 1`) of the full score field. *(since 1.5.0)*
- `let topScore: Double` — The highest score in the field — the top hit's score. *(since 1.5.0)*
- `let topZScore: Double` — How many standard deviations the top hit sits above the field's mean. Zero when the field has no spread (every score identical). *(since 1.5.0)*
- `init(hits: [RetrievedHit<Label>], scores: [Double], mean: Double, standardDeviation: Double, topScore: Double, topZScore: Double)` — Creates a retrieval result. Callers normally receive one from `retrieve(_:k:)` rather than building it directly. *(since 1.5.0)*
- `func isAboveGate(floor: Double, outlierZ: Double) -> Bool` — Whether the top hit clears a relevance gate the caller defines: its score is high enough on its own (`floor`), or it stands out as a clear outlier above the field (`outlierZ` standard deviations). Returns: `true` if the top hit clears either bar; `false` if the result is empty or the top hit clears neither. *(since 1.5.0)*

## EmbeddingIndex

`struct EmbeddingIndex<Label> where Label : Decodable, Label : Encodable, Label : Equatable` — An on-device vector store: embed each entry once at ingest, then rank the whole corpus against a query by cosine similarity. *(since 1.5.0)*

Conforms to: Sequence.

- `init(embedder: some Embedder)` — Creates an empty index that vectorizes text with the given embedder. *(since 1.5.0)*
- `mutating func add(_ text: String, label: Label)` — Embeds `text` once and stores it under `label`. *(since 1.5.0)*
- `mutating func add(vector: [Double], label: Label)` — Stores a pre-computed `vector` under `label`, without embedding. *(since 1.5.0)*
- `mutating func remove(label: Label)` — Removes every entry whose label equals `label`. *(since 1.5.0)*
- `mutating func remove(labels: [Label])` — Removes every entry whose label is contained in `labels` — for dropping a document's entries before re-adding them, without rebuilding the index. *(since 1.5.0)*
- `mutating func removeAll()` — Removes all entries, leaving the embedder in place. *(since 1.5.0)*
- `func retrieve(_ query: String, k: Int) -> RetrievalResult<Label>` — Embeds the query, scores every entry by cosine similarity, and returns the top `k` matches along with the full score field and its statistics. Returns: A `RetrievalResult` carrying the ranked hits plus the full field, its mean, spread, and the top hit's z-score. *(since 1.5.0)*
- `var vectors: [[Double]] { get }` — The stored vectors, in ingest order — the corpus matrix. Pair any two to inspect their similarity directly, e.g. `index.vectors[i].cosineOfAngle(with: index.vectors[j])`. *(since 1.5.0)*
- `func scores(for query: String) -> [Double]` — The cosine score of every entry against `query`, in storage order, without ranking — for inspecting the full field or applying a custom relevance rule. Empty when the query cannot be embedded. *(since 1.5.0)*
- `func vector(for label: Label) -> [Double]?` — The stored embedding for the first entry whose label equals `label`, or `nil` if no such entry exists. *(since 1.5.0)*
- `var count: Int { get }` — The number of stored entries. *(since 1.5.0)*
- `var isEmpty: Bool { get }` — Whether the index holds no entries. *(since 1.5.0)*
- `func makeIterator() -> IndexingIterator<[Entry]>` — Iterates the stored entries in ingest order. *(since 1.5.0)*
- `var snapshot: Snapshot { get }` — The index's persistable state — encode this with `JSONEncoder` to save the embedded corpus to disk, a database, or the network. *(since 1.5.0)*
- `init(_ snapshot: Snapshot, embedder: some Embedder)` — Reconstructs an index from a decoded `Snapshot` and an embedder. *(since 1.5.0)*

## EmbeddingIndex.Entry

`struct Entry` — One stored entry: a payload and its embedding, in ingest order. `Codable` so a built index persists to disk and loads at the next launch. *(since 1.5.0)*

Conforms to: Codable, Equatable.

- `let label: Label` — The stored payload. *(since 1.5.0)*
- `let vector: [Double]` — The embedding produced for this entry's text. *(since 1.5.0)*
- `init(label: Label, vector: [Double])` *(since 1.5.0)*

## EmbeddingIndex.Snapshot

`struct Snapshot` — The persistable state of an index: its entries, labels and vectors, without the embedder. *(since 1.5.0)*

Conforms to: Codable, Equatable.


## Dictionary extensions where Key == String, Value == [Double]

- `func nearest(to query: [Double], k: Int = 5) -> [(rank: Int, word: String, score: Double)]` — Returns the top K words in the embedding dictionary nearest to a query vector. Returns: Array of tuples containing rank (1-based), word, and similarity score, sorted by score (highest first). Returns fewer than `k` entries if the dictionary has fewer matching-dimension values. *(since 1.2.0)*

## String extensions

- `func tokenize(removingPunctuation: Bool = true) -> [String]` — Tokenizes text into individual words for text analysis and embedding workflows. Returns: An array of lowercase word tokens with empty strings removed *(since 1.2.0)*
